summary: Examples of requirements.yml role sources: Galaxy, local git+file, GitHub with name/tag/commit, tarballs from a web server, Bitbucket git and hg, and GitLab over SSH. Don't embed credentials in SCM URLs.
questions: How do I install a role from a private GitLab over SSH?
Can I install a role from a tar.gz URL?
How do I pin a role to a commit in requirements.yml?
Is it safe to put a password in the role Git URL?

answer_card.title: requirements.yml source examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: yatesr.timezone                          # Galaxy
- src: git+file:///home/bennojoy/nginx           # local clone, full path
- name: nginx_role
  src: https://github.com/bennojoy/nginx
  version: main
- src: https://github.com/bennojoy/nginx
  version: "ee8aa41"                            # commit
- name: http-role-gz
  src: https://some.webserver.example.com/files/main.tar.gz
- src: git@gitlab.company.com:mygroup/ansible-core.git
  scm: git
  version: "0.1"                                # quote so it's not a float
```
**Don't put credentials in the URL.** Use SSH, netrc, or Git config such as `http.extraHeader`.
